title: Another Week, Another Win For Bullet Brawl's GOAT Nakamura
summary: Like clockwork, GM Hikaru Nakamura won his seventh consecutive Bullet Brawl on Saturday, this time scoring 178 points and finishing ahead of 218 titled players. A 23-game winning streak in the early stages of the arena effectively assured a Nakamura victory. GM Oleksandr Bortnyk finished second with 146 points, edging IM Yoseph Taher by a single point, while IM Aleksandr Usov rounded out the top four with 134 points. Meanwhile, WIM Melika Mohammadi claimed the $100 best women's prize on tiebreaks. The next edition of Bullet Brawl will begin on Saturday, October 31, at 12 p.m. ET / 17:00 CET / 9:30 p.m. IST.
